data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, on the same shared terms Emma and Jack set out. I’ll also limit my catch to 7.5 tons next month so we can rebuild the lake. My family taught me to look after both the water and the neighbors who depend on it; this needs to remain a one-time exception, followed by sustainable catches. John, yours is the remaining commitment—will you join us for both months?
